public.prompt: Deliver a payload using a finite 2D robot simulator. A roof hides which of two lanes is open. Move the camera to inspection and use RGB pixels plus visible fiducials to recover world geometry. A contact probe measures friction but also wears the surface. Choose a route and contact mode before irreversible execution, accounting for simulated time, energy, and tool cost. A slow detour can work without recovering geometry or friction when the public deadline allows it. Read /scene/robotics_vision.json. Submit delivered=true only after a successful execution.

robot_move_camera.description: Move to the named camera station; 1 simulated time and 1 energy, even if already there.

robot_capture.description: Return PNG pixels at the current station; 1 time, no energy. Repeats have identical fixed-pattern photometric noise.

robot_probe.description: Contact the surface, apply wear, then measure friction. Gentle: 2 time, 1 energy, +1 wear. Firm: 2 time, 2 energy, +2 wear. Errors share a persistent bias.

robot_execute.description: Irreversibly execute one route/mode. Primary roll/grip: 5 time, 5 energy; primary slow: 12 time, 4 energy; detour slow: 18 time, 6 energy. No further domain actions afterward.

arguments.mode: roll, grip, or slow; detour requires slow

public.submission_rule: One final submission. Grades are evaluator-only; no retry after submission.
